channel.title: Low Quality Interactive — updates
channel.description: Devlogs and patch notes for Low Quality Interactive's Roblox games (ERADICATION, Favela '94, DON POLLO OBBY).

item.title: ERADICATION v5.0j
item.description:
New

  • Added rewards for defending a territory, claiming a territory, and engaging Whiskorians on a territory.
  • Added a reward for using the callout menu.
  • Added an assist system to credit players for contributing to kills.
  • Added a round end UI to display key stats at the conclusion of each round.

Changes

  • Slightly improved death feedback to better communicate the cause and context of a player's death.

Removals

  • Temporarily pulled back the Infection game mode pending further development.

item.title: ERADICATION v5.0i
item.description:
New

  • Added a /votekick command, allowing players to initiate a vote to remove a disruptive player via chat.

Changes

  • Finalized and hardened the anti-cheat system to a production-ready state.

Bug fixes

  • Fixed various issues occurring on the client's first death.
  • Fixed menu camera and start state issues encountered after dying.

item.title: ERADICATION v5.0h
item.description:
New

  • Boosted and added velocity-based blast physics, launching players and entities on explosion impact.
  • Added multi-vehicular support, allowing multiple instances of the same vehicle to coexist.
  • Added a selection UI to RallyDrop settings so players can clearly identify which vehicle they are configuring.

Changes

  • Overhauled explosion visuals for a better overall feel.
  • Significant security improvements across the game.

Bug fixes

  • Fixed incorrect and inaccurate explosion blast radius.
  • Fixed an issue causing tanks to totally lose functionality in water.
  • Fixed the Panzer IV failing to move.

item.title: ERADICATION v5.0g
item.description:
New

  • Added a Codes section within the Rewards UI, allowing you to redeem codes for in-game rewards, this will soon support weapons.

Changes

  • Rebranded SkyDrop to RallyDrop.
  • Revamped the RallyDrop system with overall structural and performance improvements.
  • General optimizations and improvements across the game.

item.title: ERADICATION v5.0f
item.description:
New

  • Added the M60, only available to group users
  • Added a dedicated Rewards section GUI, allowing players to view and claim all available rewards in one place.

Changes

  • Improved the level system UX for smoother progression.
  • Limited private server rewards to prevent reward farming.

item.title: ERADICATION v5.0e
item.description:
Changes

  • Revamped and standardized every GUI element across the game for a consistent visual experience.

item.title: ERADICATION v5.0d
item.description:
Changes

  • Reworked and rebalanced the Furry team.

Bug fixes

  • Fixed anti-cheat false positives incorrectly flagging legitimate players.

item.title: ERADICATION v5.0c
item.description:
New

  • Added a daily login bonus for all players.
  • New players now receive a complimentary 2-hour x2 cash and XP boost upon joining.
  • Added the option to kick players from a vehicle you own.
  • Pushed SkyDrop elements to free users.
  • Migrated cash SkyDrop to a per-round basis.

Changes

  • Replaced the existing backpack with a cleaner, improved alternative.
  • Deployed a new networking library to reduce client-to-server communication issues.

Bug fixes

  • Resolved an internal engine bug affecting vehicle tracks.
  • Fixed anti-cheat false positives incorrectly flagging legitimate players.

item.title: ERADICATION v5.0b
item.description:
Changes

  • Increased respawn time from 3 seconds to 6 seconds.

Bug fixes

  • Resolved runtime errors occurring in private servers.
  • Resolved defective datastore code causing data handling issues.
  • Fixed a visual ragdoll bug affecting player death animations.

item.title: ERADICATION v5.0a
item.description:
New

  • Added multiple game modes: Traditional, Infection, and Rush.
  • Introduced the MTV-92, a new vehicle available.
  • Added the M keybind for quick map access.
  • Implemented aim assist support for console players.
  • Extended laptop support for vehicles.

Changes

  • Overhauled the Furry boss system, only available in Traditional.
  • Revamped the vehicle system with significant structural and functional improvements.
  • Implemented player scaling to better accommodate solo players.
  • Extended background terrain, just so the map doesn't feel empty.
  • Performed extensive performance optimizations across the experience.

Bug fixes

  • Resolved inconsistent Furry attack patterns.
  • Fixed buggy callout UI elements displaying incorrectly during gameplay.

Removals

  • Removed the loading screen to reduce memory usage.
  • Eliminated erroneous tree collision geometry.

  • Increased Furry attack cooldown from 1.3s to 1.4s

  • Reworked Furry AI
  • Increased territory decay rate from 0.002 to 0.003
  • Increased ammo reserves for gamepass weapons
  • Improved weapon loadout saving
  • Reworked footstep audio
  • Reworked the Furry boss

  • Reworked explosion logic and VFX
  • Reworked overhead ranks

  • Reworked ProximityPrompts

  • Redesigned the chatbox, mobile controls, bullet casing models, both rivers, and muzzle flashes
  • Overhauled visual graphics, gamepass logic, and the shop UI
  • Refreshed all UI sounds and house models
  • Reworked the Weapon, Main Menu, Loadout, and Deploy UIs
  • Refreshed the Notification, Vehicle, and Capture UIs
  • Reworked reload animations for the AK and AR
  • Refreshed and readjusted the following weapons: AK-12, AK-74, AR-15, VSS Vintorez, M1911A1, Python, Z Custom, Five-seveN, P90, G36, G17 w/ Shield, G18, G19, Kar98k, Vector, L86A1, M16A2, Mechanical Grenadier, M4A1, M61 Vulcan, MK1 Carbine, M91/30, PPSh-41, RPG-7, RPK-74, P320, Saiga-12, Schwarzlose M.1898, Walther P99 AS, Thompson M1928
